forward: Explicit coordinate/FP32-time control on the same saved students, under no_grad; see per-axis numeric definition. New AEE required, not training-final bit equivalence.
storage: Copy NPZ values into original training strides, including Conv2 V stride32 and live sourceA/d/P parameterization; preserve frozen parent and base projection bias plus separate delta.

coordinate_function.temporal_numeric: All time products FP32, TF32 disabled, including explicit native time control; channel policy is stated separately below.
coordinate_function.channel_numeric: Every F.conv2d inside this helper (both Conv2 factors, F, U/UF/V) uses cuDNN with TF32 disabled; all other cuDNN flags and helper-external arithmetic are preserved.
coordinate_function.constants: BN fold and UF compile in FP32; As inverse and ordinary C compile in Float64 then roundFP32, no entry thresholding.
coordinate_function.shared_readout: Actual saved d64 multiplies selected FP32 coordinates in Float64 then roundsFP32; no rounded-A correction.
coordinate_function.ranges: Per-frame per-T max_abs from actual intermediate tensors only. Native does not materialize unbiased Q or AZ; native source/consumer membrane and PED latent are recorded instead.
coordinate_function.claim: New FP32 reassociation requires fresh AEE. No native bit-equivalence, buffer deletion, operator skipping or GPU-speed claim.

evaluation.claim: Dense function/accuracy check; elapsed time is not a speed comparison

training_final_alignment.scope: New coordinate/FP32-time function versus old training-final arithmetic; differences are expected, not an exact reload failure.
